scope: location-scoped Field Collector operator inventory and queue summary

authorization.location_scope: Both grants must be active for the same requested location.
authorization.tenant_context: The read-only query establishes signed transaction-bound operator context before protected reads and repeats both grant/location checks in SQL.

included: pending-sync, synced, form-review-required, and ineligible-synced counts
response_boundary.console: The panel appears only when both location grants exist; values render through textContent.

limits: Source/fake-connection and in-process ASGI acceptance only; no PostgreSQL execution was performed.
No candidate or legacy database was accessed.
No real OIDC provider, live identity, browser navigation, or external ingress was exercised.
The summary is scoped per location and does not expose cross-tenant/global totals.
